name: MDS Manufacturing Llc
old_description: Our modern high-speed liquid silicone molding equipment support press sizes up to 150 tons. We are the only Midwest manufacturer offering these services!
about:
MDS Manufacturing operates from Pacific, Missouri, where it was founded in 2009 as a family-owned business. The company traces its roots back more than 50 years to Marvin D. Skaggs, a plastics industry veteran whose legacy inspired the MDS name. Today, the firm is led by President Dave Skaggs Sr., Vice President Mike Skaggs, Chief Operating Officer Julie Round, Operations Manager Greg Rodermund, and Quality Control Manager Tyler Skaggs.

The shop provides custom plastic injection molding on presses ranging from 85 to 550 tons, liquid silicone rubber (LSR) molding on high-speed equipment up to 150 tons, and injection stretch blow molding (ISBM) to round out a one-stop-shop offering. It also handles assembly and production tooling, with 3-D prototyping samples available to validate designs before committing to mold construction. Mold lead times are quoted at 6–12 weeks depending on complexity and run size.

MDS serves customers across a broad range of industries worldwide, though the company does not list specific sectors on its site. Its capabilities suit any application requiring precision-molded plastic or silicone components, from prototype through production volumes.

The company emphasizes its family-run culture and a “customer-first philosophy” built on collaboration and transparency. It claims to be the only Midwest manufacturer offering high-speed LSR molding up to 150 tons, and it backs that differentiation with decades of hands-on experience passed down from its founder.
